content_sections.heading: BMC Trade Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written examination for this recruitment. Selection is based on: Marks obtained in the final semester of the ITI trade examination , as declared in the mela application. Applicable social reservation (SC/ST/VJ/NT-B/NT-C/NT-D/SEBC/EWS) and parallel reservation (Women 30%, Ex-servicemen 15%, Project-affected 5%, Sportspersons 5%, Earthquake-affected 2%, Orphans 1%, PwD 4%). In case of a tie in marks, preference is given to the candidate with the earlier date of birth (seniority by age). A combined merit list is prepared; high-scoring backward-class candidates are also considered against open-category posts. Selected candidates' names are published on the BMC recruitment portal, followed by document verification and an online offer. Note: Under Section 22 of the Apprentices Act, 1961, BMC is not obligated to absorb apprentices into regular service after training completion. Selected candidates must submit a written undertaking accepting this condition.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BMC Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and log in (only Maharashtra ITI-passed candidates are eligible). Under "Apprenticeship Opportunities," select MCGM (BMC) as the establishment. On the applicable mela date for your trade (20 or 21 August 2026), report in person at Jamsaheb Mukadam Government ITI, Govandi, Mumbai , between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM. Fill and submit the prescribed application form (format issued with the notification) along with self-attested photocopies of required documents. Candidates are shortlisted at the mela based on ITI final-semester marks and applicable reservation. Selected candidates undergo document verification, followed by an online offer through the portal. The offer must be accepted within 7 days , failing which the selection is cancelled and the next eligible candidate is considered. On acceptance, a Model Contract of Apprenticeship Training is executed online between the candidate and BMC. Important: Candidates must attend the mela at their own expense. No accommodation is provided by BMC during the training period.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required at the Mela
content_sections.text: School leaving certificate / birth certificate SSC (10th) mark sheet / certificate ITI mark sheet / certificate (all semesters) Caste certificate, where applicable Caste validity certificate, if available Apprenticeship India portal registration number Maharashtra domicile certificate Aadhaar card PAN card Bank account details Recent passport-size photograph Where claiming parallel reservation: ex-servicemen / disability / sportsperson / project-affected / part-time graduate / earthquake-affected certificate, as applicable

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Training period is one year ; apprentices must be physically present for training and may be assigned to any of the three shifts as per BMC's requirement. Passing the apprenticeship does not confer any right to permanent appointment in BMC service. No accommodation is provided during the training period; this is the candidate's own responsibility. Submission of false information or documents at any stage will lead to cancellation of training/contract without prior notice, and no correspondence will be entertained. Any candidate convicted of a moral turpitude or criminal offence is disqualified from selection. BMC reserves the right to postpone, modify, or cancel this recruitment process at any stage for administrative or other reasons. Reserved-category posts among the Denotified/Nomadic Tribes (VJ-A, NT-B, NT-C, NT-D) are inter-transferable as per prevailing government policy if suitable candidates are not available in a given sub-category. Selected apprentices are placed under the Chief Labour Officer's jurisdiction and may be posted to any BMC department, ward office, or hospital.

faq.question: Q1. How many Trade Apprentice posts has BMC announced for 2026?
faq.answer: BMC has announced 612 Trade Apprentice posts across 18 ITI trades under Notification No. प्रकाअ/585/एमसी dated 11.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. When and where is the BMC Apprentice recruitment mela?
faq.answer: The mela will be held on 20 and 21 August 2026, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, at Jamsaheb Mukadam Government ITI, Govandi, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q3. Do I need to apply online before the mela?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must first register on www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and select MCGM/BMC before attending the walk-in mela.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility for BMC Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SSC pass with Marathi as a subject, plus a pass in all semesters of the relevant ITI trade, and Maharashtra domicile.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for BMC apprentices?
faq.answer: Stipend ranges from ₹17,680 to ₹19,890 per month depending on the trade.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written exam for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. Selection is based on ITI final-semester marks and applicable reservation; there is no written test.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum age to apply?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 14 years as per the Apprentices Act, 1961; the maximum age is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Does the BMC apprenticeship lead to a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Under Section 22 of the Apprentices Act, 1961, BMC is not obligated to absorb apprentices into regular service after training.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the training period?
faq.answer: The training period is one year.
